# simply_dns_zone (Data Source)

Looks up Simply.com DNS zone metadata.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "simply_dns_zone" "example" {
  product = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `product` (String) Simply.com product object, usually the domain name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source ID.
- `name` (String) DNS zone name.
